hero.1: A 6-track looper for Ableton Move. It lives inside a Movy track, you play it with the pads and mix it with the knobs.
hero.11: Made by rogerbacardit × Claude (Anthropic)
hero.15: Move animation: the tracks record and play back in their colors
hero.16: The pads light up like on the real device: red = recording or overdub, green = playing, flashing orange = armed.
idea.3: Looper 606 loads as a sound on a Movy track (a Schwung sound_generator with audio input enabled). It records whatever comes in through the Move's audio input and plays it back in a loop, on six independent tracks. The pads handle record, play and overdub; the knobs are the mixer.
idea.5: Each track has its own buffer (120 seconds by default). If memory runs short, the engine automatically drops to 90, 60, 45 or 30 s.
idea.7: A 4×8 grid: column 1 = master, columns 2 to 7 = tracks, column 8 = record settings. The pads are the LEDs: color tells you the state.
idea.9: Select a track and the 8 knobs switch to that track: clip start and end, volume, pan, FX, speed and reverse.
idea.11: Arm an empty track and it starts recording by itself when the input crosses a threshold. Ideas from the RC-505 and Loopex.
idea.13: They are saved in the background to the user data partition and come back when you reload Movy or power the Move off and on.
idea.15: Supports the Blackstar Live Logic pedal on the USB-A hub, in CUSTOM mode.
idea.16: The audio engine is Mark by Tim Cox (MIT), with a custom fork modified for Looper 606. The usage ideas come from the Boss RC-505 and Loopex (ideas only, no code).
instalacion.3: The module is built for ARM and copied to Schwung's modules folder on the Move.
instalacion.5: You need aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc (the aarch64-linux-gnu toolchain) or Docker running.
instalacion.13: On the Move, on that folder: ableton:users.
instalacion.15: Restart Schwung and load the module
instalacion.16: Restart Schwung (or rescan modules). In Movy, load Looper 606 as a track's sound.
instalacion.17: For the pad LEDs, the on-screen parameter page, the step buttons, Undo, deleting with X and the pedal you need a Movy with the module-leds build (UI v13 or later for every feature, including native SHIFT + selector and the PERFORM pages). Without it the module works, but Movy ignores those parameters.
mapa.3: A grid of 4 rows × 8 columns. Row 1 = the bottom one. Column 1 = master, columns 2 to 7 = tracks 1 to 6, column 8 = record settings (REC SETTINGS). Hover (or tap) the drawing.
mapa.26: All gestures act on note-on. Green = playing, red = recording or overdub, flashing orange = ARM. Columns 1 and 8 use neither green nor red. Details of each pad in Column 1, Column 8 and Step buttons.
primerloop.3: Move forward with the buttons or leave auto-play on. The drawing highlights the pad to press; on the right you see the screen and the LED color.
primerloop.9: Stopped track: REC on a stopped track with a clip starts playing straight into DUB. Recording: PLAY/STOP closes the recording and stops.
autorec.3: Press ARM (column 1, row 3, details): one tap turns the mode on. Tapping REC on an empty track leaves it armed (flashing orange) and it starts recording by itself when the input crosses the threshold. Tap REC again to cancel.
autorec.4: Threshold in dB (SHIFT + Rec Action, col. 8 row 3, cycles through them):
autorec.6: Default -42 dB: above the line input's noise floor (around -66 dB) and below playing softly. The on-screen toast is THR -36 DB. The module accepts -70 to -6 dBFS in its settings.
pista.3: On row 4, tapping a track's pad selects it: the 8 knobs now control that track and the waveform follows it. Tap the same one again to go back to MIX (knobs = volumes). Every turn shows a toast like T3 IN +8/16. The Move's screen shows a Schwung-style parameter page; while you turn IN/OUT (and for about 2.5 s after) it switches to the zoomed waveform, then returns to the page. The value of the last knob you turned replaces its label for 1.5 s.
pista.6: tap a row 4 pad or a knob
pista.7: Animated screen (2 rows × 4: dial for continuous values, text box for options). Turn IN/OUT to see the zoom.
pista.8: Real capture of the PISTA view page on the Move
pista.12: IN: clip start (1/16 grid, no fine mode). While you turn it, the screen switches to the waveform with ZOOM.
pista.13: OUT: loop end/length (1/16 grid, no fine mode; shortening is non-destructive). OUT never pushes IN: it stays 1/16 after IN.
pista.16: FX type: OFF / LPF / HPF / CRUSH / DELAY / PHASER / RING (3 clicks per step)
pista.18: Speed x1/4, x1/2, x3/4, x1, x1.5, x2, x4 (3 clicks per step; overdub only at x1 and without reverse)
pista.19: Reverse off / on (3 clicks; right is on, left is off)
pista.20: In MIX: K1 to K6 volume of tracks 1 to 6, K7 input, K8 master.
pista.21: With the PISTA view active, pedals 3 and 4 also move the selection, and pads of other tracks don't change the waveform's track. Selector pads are in the track color (dim), and bright when selected, never green or red.
inout.3: On the waveform (128×64) you see bar marks (short, top and bottom), phrase marks every 4 bars (taller: bars 1, 5, 9…) and beat dots, counted from IN. K1 moves IN, K2 moves OUT: while you turn (and for about 2.5 s after) the screen switches from the knob page to the waveform with a 2-bar zoom centered on the point. Afterwards it returns to the page by itself.
inout.8: PISTA: the screen shows the knob page; turning IN/OUT jumps to the zoomed waveform with IN/OUT marks (the whole buffer if the clip is shorter than the window).
inout.9: MIX: the waveform shows only the region that plays (IN to OUT) at full width, with bars counted from IN: the clip changes size as you trim it.
inout.10: K1 and K2 always move in 1/16 steps, no fine mode. OUT never pushes IN: it stays 1/16 after IN. A burst of turns = one Undo step.
inout.11: The cursor follows the real audio: with reverse it goes right to left; at x2 / x1/2 it moves at double / half speed.
inout.13: Hold Loop and turn knob N (1 to 6): it moves the start of track N without destroying audio. The engine plays from (pos + start) mod length and overdub writes at the same point, so layers stay aligned (works with reverse and speed). Each step = a 1/16 note; with Shift held = 1/64 (fine, only in this gesture; shows +N MS). It can't be moved while the track records or overdubs (START 1 LOCKED) or if it's empty.
velocidad.3: K7 picks the speed: x1/4, x1/2, x3/4, x1, x1.5, x2, x4 (3 clicks per step). It changes pitch like tape and works with reverse. K8 (or SHIFT + row 1 pad) toggles reverse for that track. You can't overdub at any speed other than x1.
velocidad.6: Old saved states (speed 1/2x, 1x, 2x) load as x1/2, x1, x2. Old reverse alias: hold ARM and tap a track pad (row 1 or 2).
pasos.3: The 16 buttons under the pads (the Move's step buttons) set the length in bars, from 1 to 16, of the selected track (the last track pad you tapped). Click a step in the drawing and watch the loop change.
pasos.12: With a clip: changes the length
pasos.13: Step N sets the loop to N bars (at the current tempo), even on an already recorded clip. Shorter = non-destructive trim: the audio is kept and lengthening again brings it back. Longer than recorded = the content repeats until it fills it (RC-505 style), up to what fits in the track; otherwise, LEN 1: TOO LONG. Overdub, reverse, speed and start stay aligned. Undo restores the previous length.
pasos.14: Empty track: length of the next recording
pasos.15: Step N sets a length of N bars for upcoming recordings. Pressing the lit step again = free length (FREE). Toasts LEN 4 BARS / LEN FREE. It's the same setting as Fixed length (column 8) and Setup's Fixed Length.
pasos.17: They show the length of the selected clip, or of the next recordings if it's empty: step N white, steps 1 to N-1 dim, the rest off. Free = all off (also if the clip isn't a whole number of bars).
pasos.19: Hold Loop and turn knob N (1 to 6): it moves the start (IN) of track N in 1/16 steps without destroying audio. With Shift, 1/64 (fine). More on IN/OUT.
pasos.20: On a track with this module, the step buttons are not Movy's sequencer (Shift + step, Mute + step and the Session view stay the same). Requires Movy with the module-leds build.
shift.2: The top pad of column 1 (MASTER) is the looper's SHIFT (dim grey, white while held). While it is pressed, the pads change function. Try it: turn on SHIFT and tap row 4 (FX CLR) or row 3 (SOLO).
shift.4: SHIFT released. Tap the row 3 pad to silence (MUTE).
shift.8: FX CLR: turns off its PERFORM effects and track FX, removes reverse, speed x1 and clears its automation (audio, volume, pan and mute are untouched); the pad shows white if it has FX
shift.12: SOLO: mutes the others; again = removes the solo and restores the previous mutes (the soloed track's pad flashes)
shift.14: Cycles the count between 1 and 2 bars (COUNT-IN 2 BARS)
undo.2: Clear the audio or reset the track to zero
undo.3: Hold the Move's <kbd>Delete (X)</kbd> and tap a pad in a track's column. The pad you tap decides what gets cleared:
undo.4: X + pad on rows 1 to 3 = CLEAR
undo.5: Clears only the audio. The track keeps its settings (FX, volume, pan, speed, reverse, one-shot, mute). Can be undone. Toast CLEAR 2.
undo.7: The track's settings go back to factory: FX and amount at default, volume (100), pan (centre), speed (x1), reverse, one-shot, mute and solo; its PERFORM effects turn off and its automation is cleared. The audio and IN / OUT are untouched. It cannot be undone. Toast RESET FX 2.
undo.8: The Move's Undo button reverts it; Shift + Undo redoes. Undoing a full RESET brings back the audio and the settings. If the track was empty, its full RESET is applied but cannot be undone (there was no audio to recover); RESET FX cannot be undone either. UNDO is single-level: it covers the last overdub, recording, CLEAR, full RESET or length change. On other tracks, Undo is still Movy's own.
undo.9: Try it: CLEAR, RESET FX and RESET
undo.11: Track 1 (column 2). Click X, a pad in column 2 and Undo.
undo.21: CLEAR + UNDO also brings back the start point. A CLEAR deletes the .wav from disk and UNDO writes it again. The pedal (holding switch 2) only clears the audio, like a CLEAR.
pedalera.3: Plug the pedal into the Move's USB-A hub, in CUSTOM mode (not PATCH). It needs Movy's module-leds build, which forwards the 6 switches to the looper. It always acts on the selected track (the one the screen and waveform follow); the toast is TRACK n. Press the switches in the drawing (hold 2 or 3 for 1 s for the long gesture).
pedalera.18: REC/DUB/PLAY of the selected track (like the row 1 pad)
pedalera.19: PLAY/STOP of the selected track (like the row 2 pad)
pedalera.20: CLEAR of the selected track (can be undone)
pedalera.22: ARM auto-rec on/off (at 1 s, without releasing)
pedalera.25: STOP ALL if something is playing; otherwise, ALL START
pedalera.26: Switches 1, 4, 5 and 6 act on press. Switches 2 and 3 have a hold gesture, so their tap acts on release (if released before 1 s); a hold never also fires the tap.
persistencia.3: Loops survive closing or reloading Movy and powering the Move off. Movy saves the state the module publishes per track and per Set; that state carries a random loops ID, and the audio lives in the user data partition, which isn't wiped when you update Movy or Schwung.
persistencia.4: 1 · WatchA dedicated thread checks a cheap signature of each track every 100 ms.
persistencia.5: 2 · WaitSaves tracks that changed once they've been stable for 1.5 s. Nothing is written during REC/DUB.
persistencia.7: 4 · Closeloops.json is written last (lengths and start points).
persistencia.8: 5 · ReloadWhen loading a Set with an ID and only if the instance is empty, it reads the WAVs and leaves the tracks in STOP.
persistencia.9: /data/UserData/schwung/looper-loops/ └─ <id>/ (12 hex, per instance) ├─ t1.wav ├─ ... ├─ t6.wav └─ loops.json
persistencia.10: It's never saved on the audio thread. CLEAR deletes the .wav (UNDO writes it again). Fixed length, speed, mute, count-in, threshold, input volume and knob automation come back too. Selection, view and solo aren't saved.
persistencia.12: A Set duplicated by Movy shares its ID with the original until one of them records something new.
persistencia.13: Removing the module from a track leaves its folder orphaned (you can delete it by hand).
persistencia.14: An unreadable folder is never overwritten.
persistencia.15: Movy puts a track to sleep when its audio has been silent for ~1 s: while any tracks are in use, the module adds ±8 LSB of dither (about -72 dBFS) so the looper keeps running.
chuleta.2: All the gestures in one table
chuleta.6: REC (row 1) on the track; second tap closes
chuleta.8: REC on a playing track (DUB, red); again returns to PLAY
chuleta.15: SHIFT + row 1, or K8 in PISTA view
chuleta.16: FX CLR (turn off the track's effects)
chuleta.17: SHIFT + row 4 (or the Move's SHIFT + selector)
chuleta.21: ARM (col. 1, row 3), then REC on an empty track
chuleta.23: Tap ARM (col. 1, row 3); hold it + row 1 or 2 pad = Reverse
chuleta.29: Step buttons 1 to 16 (the lit one again = free), or Fixed length (col. 8 row 2)
chuleta.30: What happens when a recording closes
chuleta.36: Move start without entering the track
chuleta.37: Hold Loop + knob N (with Shift, fine)
chuleta.39: K7 in PISTA view (x1/4 to x4)
chuleta.42: Track settings back to factory (RESET FX)
chuleta.47: Col. 1 row 1 (STOP ALL: stop only) / row 2 (ALL START/STOP: toggle)
chuleta.49: 1 REC/DUB/PLAY · 2 PLAY/STOP (on release; hold 1 s = CLEAR) · 3 previous track (on release; hold 1 s = ARM) · 4 next track · 5 UNDO · 6 STOP ALL / START
creditos.4: The idea, the design and the testing on the Move. Author and maintainer of Looper 606.
creditos.7: Built with Claude Code: the module's code, the Movy patch and this website. A big part of the work is Claude's.
creditos.10: Audio engine by Tim Cox (MIT), schwung-mark. Looper 606 includes its own modified fork (see LICENSE-mark).
creditos.12: The Movy module is by DimaDake. Looper 606 loads inside a Movy track.
creditos.14: The module platform that Looper 606 is a sound_generator for.
creditos.15: The usage ideas come from the Boss RC-505 and Loopex (ideas only, no code). Code and documentation: github.com/rogerbacardit/movy-looper.

meta.title: Looper 606: manual
meta.desc: Looper 606: a 6-track looper for Ableton Move that runs inside Movy. Interactive manual: pads, knobs, PISTA view, auto-rec, pedal and more.
map.stepd: With a clip: sets the loop to {0} bar(s). Empty track: sets the length of the next recordings (again = free). Acts on the selected track.
map.hint.t: Tap or hover a pad, knob or button
map.hint.d: The description appears here. Switch between SHIFT / MIX or PISTA view with the controls above.
pi.1.4.d: Hold it down. Dim gray; white while held. Enables the SHIFT shortcuts of the other pads.
pi.1.3.d: One tap (press and release) turns "record when sound is detected" mode on or off. Flashes orange when active. Held + row 1 or 2 pad of a track = Reverse.
pi.1.2.d: Toggle: if something is playing, stops everything; otherwise, starts every stopped track with a clip. White if something is playing, gray if not.
pi.1.1.d: Panic: stop only. Stops every track and cancels armed tracks and count-ins; never starts anything. Bright yellow if anything is playing, unlit if not.
pi.8.4.d: Turns on or off the 1-bar (4-beat) pre-count before recording on an empty track. Bright white = on, dim = off.
pi.8.4.s: SHIFT: cycles the count-in between 1 and 2 bars (not saved).
pi.8.3.d: REC>PLAY or REC>DUB: what happens when a recording closes. Bright white = REC>DUB, dim white = REC>PLAY.
pi.8.3.s: SHIFT: cycles the ARM threshold -54 / -48 / -42 / -36 / -30 dB (toast THR -36 DB).
pi.8.2.d: Each tap cycles FREE, 1, 2, 4, 8 bars (and FREE again); the recording closes by itself. Brightness shows the length.
pi.8.1.d: Turns quantization on: REC waits for the next bar and the length is rounded to whole bars. Bright white = on, dim = off. It never blocks a recording.
pi.t.4.d: Selects track {0}: the 8 knobs become that track's (TRACK view). Tapping the selected one goes back to MIX. With X held: RESET FX (settings back to factory, the audio stays).
pi.t.4.s: SHIFT: FX CLR for track {0} (effects, track FX, reverse and speed off; shows white if FX is on). SHIFT + X: full RESET.
pi.t.3.d: Silences the track but it keeps spinning; when you unmute it comes back right in place. Mute = gray. With X held: CLEAR.
pi.t.3.s: SHIFT: SOLO of track {0}. Again removes it and restores the previous mutes.
pi.t.2.d: Stopped goes to PLAY; playing or in DUB goes to STOP; recording closes the recording and stops. Green = playing. Hold X and tap the pad to clear the audio (CLEAR).
pi.t.1.d: Empty: records. Second tap closes (PLAY, or DUB if Rec Action = REC>DUB). PLAY to DUB and DUB to PLAY. Red = REC and DUB. With X held: removes the last overdub layer or, if there is none, erases the audio.
pi.t.1.s: SHIFT: REVERSE of track {0} (never records). In PERFORM with an effect on, holding REC and turning K1-K3 records its automation.
ki.mix.1.d: In MIX (nothing selected) K1 to K6 are the volumes of tracks 1 to 6.
ki.pista.1.d: Clip start, in 1/16 steps (no fine mode). While you turn it (and 2.5 s after) the screen shows the waveform with a 2-bar ZOOM centered on IN.
ki.pista.2.d: Loop end / length (1/16 steps, no fine mode). Shortening doesn't destroy the audio. OUT never pushes IN: it stays 1/16 after. It also ZOOMs.
ki.pista.5.d: OFF / LPF / HPF / CRUSH / DELAY / PHASER / RING (3 clicks per step).
ki.pista.7.d: x1/4, x1/2, x3/4, x1, x1.5, x2, x4 (3 clicks per step). No overdub unless it's x1 forward.
bt.loop.d: Hold Loop and turn knob N (1 to 6): it moves the start of track N without destroying audio (1/16 step; with Shift 1/64, fine). While Loop is held, Movy doesn't enter Loop mode on this track.
bt.x.d: Hold X and tap a pad in a track's column. Rows 2 and 3: CLEAR (audio only). REC: removes the last overdub. Row 4 selector: RESET FX (settings back to factory, the audio stays). With the looper SHIFT pad held: full RESET. Undo reverts CLEAR and the full RESET.
bt.undo.d: Undoes the last overdub, recording, CLEAR, RESET or length change (one level). Shift + Undo = redo. On other tracks it remains Movy's Undo.
bt.display.d: In PISTA view it shows the 8-parameter page and, when you turn IN/OUT, the zoomed waveform. In MIX it shows the waveform of the IN..OUT region, with bars and cursor.
walk.0.d: You load Looper 606 as the sound of a Movy track. All six tracks are empty: the REC and MUTE pads show dim in each track's colour (blue, cyan, yellow, lime, pink, orange). The PLAY/STOP row is off.
walk.1.d: With count-in on, the looper waits 1 bar (4 beats) before recording. The REC pad flashes bright yellow during the count.
walk.2.d: The signal comes in and the REC pad turns red. The waveform grows on screen. Play instruments, voice or whatever comes in through the audio input.
walk.3.d: A second tap on REC closes the recording. The track goes to PLAY: the row 2 pad turns green and the loop spins. (If Rec Action = REC>DUB it would go straight to DUB.)
walk.4.d: With the track playing, REC becomes DUB: the pad stays red and everything you play is added to the loop without interrupting playback. The waveform gets denser.
walk.5.d: Another tap on REC closes the overdub and returns to PLAY. You can stack as many layers as you want (one level of Undo).
walk.6.d: The row 3 pad silences the track, but the loop keeps spinning silently. It shows gray. When you unmute it comes back exactly in place, without losing the bar.
walk.7.d: The row 2 pad stops the track (it stays in its dim track color because it keeps the clip) and starts it again when tapped again.
walk.7.l: STOP with clip: dim track color
walk.8.d: Hold the Move's X (Delete) button and tap a pad in rows 1 to 3 of the track: the audio is erased (CLEAR) and the track keeps its settings. The Undo button brings it back. With X + the selector (row 4) the track's settings go back to factory (RESET FX) without touching the audio.
io.info: IN = bar {0} · OUT = bar {1} · {2}-bar loop · {3} view
speed.rev: reverse: the playhead goes right to left
speed.od.off: overdub disabled (only at x1 and without reverse)
ra.note: Same gesture (second tap on REC), different destination: with REC>PLAY the track plays; with REC>DUB it goes straight into overdub and you can keep playing on top.
sim.hint: Press STOP ALL or ALL START/STOP and watch the tracks.
sim.stopall.did: STOP ALL: all tracks stopped. Press it again and nothing happens: it never starts.
sim.stopall.none: STOP ALL with everything stopped: does nothing (doesn't start).
sim.all.stop: ALL START/STOP with something playing: stops all tracks. Press again and they start.
sim.all.start: ALL START/STOP with everything stopped: starts the tracks with a clip (6 stays empty).
sim.all.none: ALL START/STOP: there is no clip to start.
steps.hint: Click a step button in the drawing: the 4-bar loop changes length.
steps.hint.empty: Empty track: step N sets the length of the next recording. Press the lit one again = free.
steps.short: Step {0}: non-destructive trim to {0} bar(s). The audio is kept; lengthening again brings it back.
steps.long: Step {0}: longer than recorded, the content repeats until it fills it (hatched), RC-505 style. If it doesn't fit in the track: LEN 1: TOO LONG.
steps.next: The next recording will last {0} bar(s) and close by itself. Press the same step again to go back to free.
steps.free: Free length: the loop will last as long as you record. All LEDs off.
shift.off: SHIFT released. Tap the row 3 pad to silence (MUTE).
shift.on: SHIFT held: row 4 = FX CLR (white = FX on), row 3 = SOLO, row 1 = Reverse.
shift.solo: SOLO track {0}: the others are muted. The pad flashes.
shift.rev: SHIFT + row 1: REVERSE of track {0} (never records).
undo.hint: Track 1 has audio and changed settings. Try CLEAR, RESET FX or full RESET, then Undo.
undo.hint.empty: Empty track with changed settings. Try RESET FX or full RESET: they apply, but cannot be undone.
undo.needaudio: The track is empty: record first.
undo.dub: Overdub added. Undo will undo it (one level).
undo.clear: CLEAR: X + pad on rows 1 to 3. Only the audio is cleared; settings stay. Undo brings the audio back.
undo.reset: Full RESET: looper SHIFT + X + selector (row 4). Audio and settings go back to zero. Undo brings both back.
undo.reset.empty: Full RESET on an empty track: the settings go back to zero, but there is no audio to recover, so it cannot be undone.
undo.undo.reset: Undo of the RESET: audio and all settings come back.
undo.undo.clear: Undo of the CLEAR: audio comes back (settings never left).
undo.undo.dub: Undo: the previous state comes back. Shift + Undo = redo.
pedal.clear: TRACK {0} · CLEAR (audio only, can be undone)
hero.legend: On small screens the labels are hidden. Column 1: SHIFT, ARM, ALL, STOP ALL. Tracks, top to bottom: selector, MUTE, PLAY/STOP, REC. Column 8: COUNT-IN, REC>PLAY/DUB, LEN, QUANT. Step buttons: 1 to 16 = length in bars.
v08.play.p: The Move's Play/Stop now controls the looper. Stop = STOP ALL, but it remembers which tracks were playing (a second Stop keeps that memory). Play restarts exactly those tracks from the loop start, on the bar if Quantize is on; if nothing is remembered, it starts every track that holds audio (like ALL START). A track that is recording is left alone.
v08.mute.h: M + track = mute the whole looper
v08.mute.p: Movy's track mute (M + the track button) silences the looper's whole output with a short fade. The 6 tracks keep running in time and the screen header shows MUTED. Needs Movy's module-leds build.
cs.play.a: Move's Stop = STOP ALL that remembers what was playing; Play = restarts those tracks from the start (on the bar with Quantize)
cs.mute.a: M + a Movy track button (the screen shows MUTED; tracks keep running)
hero.info.t: Click a pad, knob or button on the drawing
hero.info.d: Here you'll see what that control does. Knobs change role depending on the view (MIX or PISTA) the animation is showing.
c1.lede: Column 1 belongs to no track: it governs the whole looper. Top to bottom: SHIFT, ARM, ALL START/STOP and STOP ALL. It uses greys, white, yellow and orange, never the green or red of the tracks. Tap a card or a pad on the drawing.
c1.s.p1: A short tap (under 300 ms, without touching anything else) turns PERFORM mode on or off: the 16 step buttons become effects and the pad flashes white. Held it is a modifier: while you hold it, other pads change function.
c1.s.p2: Dim grey at rest, white while held, flashing white with PERFORM mode on. Holding it or using a combo does not toggle PERFORM mode on release.
c1.s.c.1: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + track selector (row 4): FX CLR (turns off the track's effects and FX, removes reverse and speed, clears its automation)
c1.s.c.4: Move's native <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + selector (FX CLR) or + MUTE (SOLO) does the same without using this pad
c1.s.c.6: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + Delete + selector: full RESET of the track (with audio)
c1.s.c.7: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + column 8: count-in 1/2 bars, ARM threshold, MONITOR
c1.a.p1: A tap turns auto-rec on or off: with ARM on, REC on an empty track leaves it armed (flashing orange) and it starts recording by itself when the input exceeds the threshold. Turning ARM off cancels the armed tracks.
c1.a.p2: With SHIFT: no function. The SHIFT + ARM AUTO-REC is gone: knob automation is now recorded by holding REC in PERFORM mode (see Effects).
c1.a.p3: As a modifier: hold ARM and tap a pad in row 1 or 2 of a track to reverse it (Reverse). Hold ARM and turn an effect knob to erase its automation.
c1.st.p1: Panic button: it only stops. It stops all tracks at once (if any is recording, it closes the recording and stops) and cancels armed tracks and countdowns. Tapping it again starts nothing.
c1.st.p2: Bright yellow if anything is playing; unlit if everything is stopped.
c1.al.p1: One switch for everything: if anything is playing, recording or overdubbing, it stops all tracks (they go back to the start). If nothing is playing, it starts every stopped track that has a clip (empty ones stay empty).
c1.al.p2: White if anything is playing; grey if not.
c1.sim.p: STOP ALL is the panic button: it only stops and never starts. ALL START/STOP is a switch: the same pad stops and starts, depending on whether anything is playing. Try it with six tracks (1 to 4 are playing, 5 is stopped with a clip, 6 is empty):
c1.t.b3: Starts the tracks with a clip
ct.h2: Four pads per track, six identical tracks
ct.lede: Columns 2 to 7 are tracks 1 to 6, and all six work the same way: each column is a track with its own colour (blue, cyan, yellow, lime, pink, orange). Top to bottom: selector, MUTE, PLAY/STOP and REC/DUB. Tap a card to see the four pads on all six tracks.
ct.sel.p1: A tap selects the track: the 8 knobs now belong to that track (PISTA view: IN, OUT, volume, pan, FX, amount, speed, reverse) and the screen follows it. Tapping the selected track again goes back to MIX (knobs = volumes).
ct.sel.p2: In PERFORM mode the selector chooses which track the effects go to; with no track selected, the effects go to the whole mix (MIX).
ct.sel.p3: Dim track colour; bright if selected. With SHIFT held: white if its FX is on.
ct.sel.c.1: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + selector: FX CLR (PERFORM effects and track FX off, reverse off, speed x1, automation cleared)
ct.sel.c.2: <kbd>X</kbd> Delete + selector: RESET FX (settings back to factory, effects off and automation cleared; audio and IN / OUT are untouched)
ct.sel.c.3: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + <kbd>X</kbd> + selector: full RESET, audio included (can be undone)
ct.mute.p1: Silences the track but it keeps running in time: when you unmute it comes back exactly in place.
ct.mute.p2: Track colour if playing; grey if muted; flashing if soloed.
ct.mute.c.1: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + MUTE: SOLO (silences the others; again restores the previous mutes)
ct.play.p1: Stopped track → PLAY. Playing or overdubbing → STOP (goes back to the start). Recording → closes the recording and stops.
ct.play.p2: Green = playing, track colour = stopped with a clip, off = empty.
ct.play.c.1: <kbd>ARM</kbd> held + PLAY/STOP: Reverse of the track
ct.rec.p1: Empty track → records. Second tap → closes the recording and goes to PLAY (or to DUB if Rec Action = REC>DUB). PLAY → DUB (overdub on top); DUB → PLAY. Stopped track → starts playing straight into DUB.
ct.rec.p2: Solid red = recording or overdubbing; flashing red = waiting for the bar (Quantize); flashing yellow = count-in; flashing orange = armed (auto-rec).
ct.rec.c.3: <kbd>X</kbd> + REC: removes the last overdub layer (UNDO DUB) or, if there is none, erases the audio
ct.note: All gestures act on press (note-on). The 16 step buttons and the knobs of the PISTA view act on the selected track. To undo: the Move's Undo button (Shift + Undo = redo).
c8.h2: The recording settings, pad by pad
c8.lede: Column 8 stores how recording works. From top to bottom: Count-in, Rec Action, Fixed length and Quantize. All four pads are white: bright = active or different from the default, dim = off. With SHIFT they have a second function. Tap a card or a pad in the drawing.
c8.ci.p1: When recording on an empty track, it waits 1 bar (4 beats) before starting. The REC pad flashes yellow during the count.
c8.ci.p2: SHIFT + pad: cycles the count between 1 and 2 bars (notice COUNT-IN 2 BARS; not saved).
c8.ra.p1: What happens when you close a recording (second tap on REC, or automatic close with fixed length): REC>PLAY (dim white) the track plays; REC>DUB (bright white) goes straight into overdub.
c8.ra.p2: SHIFT + pad: cycles the ARM threshold -54 / -48 / -42 / -36 / -30 dB (notice THR -36 DB).
c8.fl.p1: Each tap cycles FREE → 1 → 2 → 4 → 8 → FREE bars. With a fixed length, the recording closes by itself when it gets there (and goes to PLAY or DUB according to Rec Action). The pad brightness shows the length.
c8.fl.p2: The 16 step buttons pick any length from 1 to 16: it is the same setting and it is saved with the Set.
c8.q.p1: With Quantize on (default), if anything is playing REC waits for the start of the next bar (the REC pad flashes red) and, on closing, the length is rounded to whole bars. With off everything is immediate and the length is exact. It never blocks a recording: at 1.5 bars + 0.5 s it starts by itself.
c8.q.p2: SHIFT + pad: MONITOR on/off, listen to the live input (notice MONITOR ON).
fx.lede: Looper 606 has two kinds of effects: the 25 PERFORM effects, played live with the step buttons, and the track FX, one fixed effect per track set with the knobs of the TRACK view. The screenshots for effects 1 to 17 come straight from the module's own code.
fx.how.1p: A short tap on the top pad of column 1 turns PERFORM mode on (notice PERFORM ON, SHIFT flashes white). Another tap turns it off.
fx.how.2p: Tap a track's selector (row 4) so the effects go to that track. With no track selected they go to the whole looper output (MIX).
fx.how.3p: A tap turns the effect on and it stays on; another tap turns it off. Hold (over 300 ms) = momentary, it turns off on release. Knobs K1-K3 control the effect you just touched.
fx.how.4p: You can have up to 6 effects at once (the seventh warns PERFORM: MAX 6). They are always chained in the same order: time → pitch/tape → ring mod → filters → comb, chorus, flanger, phaser → drive → bitcrush → gate → sidechain → autopan, tremolo → kill → delay/freeze.
fx.cap.page1: Page 1: 4×4 grid with effects 1 to 16, in the order of the step buttons. The title says the target (PISTA 1 or MIX).
fx.cap.page2: Page 2 (<kbd>></kbd> button; <kbd><</kbd> goes back): SIDECHAIN on step 1 and eight new effects on steps 2 to 9.
fx.cap.lat: With effects on: a solid underline and a square in the corner (filled = latched, hollow = momentary).
fx.cap.combo: Combining: the scene is the current effect's and, on the left, labels with the others.
fx.dev.h: The step buttons in PERFORM mode
fx.dev.p: Each step button lights up in the colour of its family. Tap a step in the drawing or a card.
fx.1.p: Repeats the slice of audio just before, aligned to the loop grid. The classic beat repeat for rolls and repeats.
fx.1.k2: decay: how much each repeat drops
fx.1.k3: drop: lowers the pitch on each repeat (0 to 12 semitones)
fx.2.p: Repeats that speed up from 1/4 to the final rate, like a roll that closes in.
fx.2.k3: acceleration curve: from linear to exponential
fx.3.p: Changes the pitch without changing the time (40 ms granular).
fx.4.p: Reduces bit depth and sample rate: dirty, digital, video-game-console sound.
fx.5.p: Tape stop and start. When turned on the tape slows down to silence (speed and pitch drop); when turned off it starts up again in time. Momentary: press = stop, release = start.
fx.6.p: Cyclic modulation synced to the loop: a sweep that repeats. It comes in with a 30 ms ramp and when turned off everything returns exactly.
fx.6.k1: rate: 14 synced divisions (1/32 to 8 bars) and 11 free rates (0.05 to 32 Hz) on a single stepped knob
fx.6.k2: target: FILT (low-pass filter), VOL, PAN, PTCH (±7 semitones)
fx.7.p: Reads the audio backwards from the moment you press (up to about 2.9 s, then starts again).
fx.8.p: A slowing record: the pitch falls slowly (without stopping) with vinyl crackle.
fx.9.p: Resonant low-pass filter: removes highs. The cutoff follows the knob with smoothing.
fx.10.p: Resonant high-pass filter: removes lows. Ideal for setting up an entrance.
fx.11.p: Rhythmic gate synced to the loop: opens the first half of each cell and cuts the other.
fx.12.p: Audio enters the delay only while the effect is on; on release, the echoes keep sounding and die out by themselves.
fx.13.p: Freezes a slice in an infinite crossfaded loop that keeps sounding even if nothing comes in.
fx.14.p: DJ retrigger: each grid unit repeats its first quarter by jumping to the start, always in time.
fx.14.k2: lowers the volume on each retrigger
fx.14.k3: lowers the pitch on each retrigger (0 to 4 semitones)
fx.15.p: Reads at ½ or ¼ speed (pitch falls) and comes back in time on each cycle.
fx.16.p: Immediate silence (3 ms fade), or cuts only the lows or only the highs.
fx.16.k1: part: ALL, LOW or HIGH (24 dB/oct)
fx.16.k3: LOW/HIGH cutoff frequency: 60 Hz to 12 kHz
fx.17.p: Sidechain-style pumping: the volume ducks on each grid cell and rises again. It is on effects page 2 (> button), on step 1.
fx.17.k3: curve: how long it takes to come back
fx.au.p: With an effect on, hold the REC pad (row 1) of a playing track and turn K1-K3: what you turn is recorded (256 steps, interpolated) across that track's loop. One cycle runs from IN to OUT at any speed; with reverse it follows the audio. On release it plays back in a loop; a short tap of REC is still the normal REC. Delete + knob, or ARM + knob, clears that knob's curve. It is saved with the Set.
fx.mo.p: Without entering PERFORM mode: hold <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> and hold a step. The effect sounds while you hold it and on release everything returns exactly as it was, in time.
fx.safe.p: Effects only act on the output: they never write into the recorded audio. When you turn them off, the sound is identical to before (except the DELAY THROW tail, which dies out by itself). They come in and out with short fades, no clicks.
fx.trk.h: Track FX (PISTA view, knobs K5 and K6)
fx.trk.p: Each track also has one fixed effect. Select the track and turn K5 to choose the type (OFF, LPF, HPF, CRUSH, DELAY, PHASER, RING) and K6 for the amount. SHIFT + selector turns it off (FX CLR, along with that track's PERFORM effects). Unlike PERFORM, it stays on and is saved with the track.
fx.t1.p: Removes highs. The amount (K6) is the cutoff, from about 60 Hz to 11 kHz.
fx.t2.p: Removes lows. The amount is the cutoff, from about 40 Hz to 10 kHz.
fx.t3.p: Reduces resolution: it holds samples and quantizes harder the more you raise the amount.
fx.t4.p: Tempo-synced echo (1/8). The amount raises the feedback and the mix together.
fx.t5.p: 4-stage sweep. The amount is the sweep speed, from 0.05 to 2.5 Hz.
fx.t6.p: Multiplies the audio by a sine wave: metallic sound. The amount is the frequency, from 30 Hz to 1 kHz.
led.tsel.2: with SHIFT: white if its FX is on
led.tplay.1: stopped with a clip: track colour
led.trec.1: waiting for the bar: flashing red
cols.hint: Tap the track pads in the drawing: record, play, mute or select.
cols.sel: Track {0} selected: the knobs now belong to this track (PISTA view).
cols.mix: No track selected: knobs on MIX (volumes).
cols.mute: Track {0} muted: it keeps running silently.
cols.noclip: Track {0}: it is empty, there is nothing to play. Record first with REC.
cols.stop: Track {0}: STOP (goes back to the start).
cols.rec2play: Track {0}: closes the recording and plays (REC>PLAY).
cols.play2dub: Track {0}: overdub, you record on top (red).
cols.dub2play: Track {0}: ends the overdub and keeps playing.
cols.stop2dub: Track {0}: was stopped, starts straight into overdub.
pista.perf: In PERFORM mode (or with SHIFT held, which shows the PERFORM page) the knobs never touch IN, OUT or speed: with an effect on they go to the effect; with no effect they do nothing to the clip.
inout.perf: In PERFORM mode the knobs do not move IN or OUT, and <kbd>Loop</kbd> + knob is ignored too.
ct.rec.c.4: In PERFORM mode with an effect on: holding REC on a playing track and turning K1-K3 records the knob automation
fx.how.5t: Look at the grid or the scene
fx.how.5p: <kbd><</kbd> and <kbd>></kbd> change page and always show its grid; at the end they toggle between grid and scene. Holding SHIFT (without pressing a step) shows the grid while held. Turning a knob brings back the effect's scene.
fx.sens.p: Each K1-K3 is continuous or stepped. A stepped knob accumulates clicks: it moves one position every 10 clicks (up to 4 positions), every 6 (up to 8) or every 3 (long lists), and the toast shows the option (RATE 32HZ). Continuous knobs respond finely (0.5 % per click with REC held) and only accelerate on very fast turns. Automation of a stepped knob records exact positions, with no interpolation.
fx.pk.p: In PERFORM mode (or with SHIFT held) the knobs never move IN, OUT or speed: with an effect on they go to the effect; with no effect they do nothing to the clip. Loop + knob is ignored too.
fx.clr.p: <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> + selector (FX CLR) turns off that track's PERFORM effects, its track FX, reverse and speed, and clears its automation. <kbd>X</kbd> + selector (RESET FX) also puts volume, pan and mute back to factory. The audio is never touched.
fx.18.p: Saturation: squeezes and warms up the sound.
fx.19.p: Ring modulation: multiplies the signal by a carrier for metallic timbres.
fx.19.k2: mode: FREE (free carrier) or NOTE (locked to the semitone)
fx.20.p: Flanger: a comb sweep with feedback.
fx.21.p: 4-stage phaser: notches that travel across the spectrum.
fx.22.p: Chorus: detuned, swaying copies that widen the sound.
fx.23.p: Auto-pan: the sound sweeps left to right in time with the tempo.
fx.24.p: Tremolo: the volume oscillates in time with the tempo.
fx.25.p: Resonant comb filter: gives any sound a tuned metallic tone.
shift.fxclr: SHIFT + row 4: FX CLR on track {0}: effects off, reverse off, speed x1.
shift.fxnone: SHIFT + row 4: track {0} had no effects to turn off.
sh.native: Move's native SHIFT + selector (FX CLR) or + MUTE pad (SOLO) does the same without touching the looper's SHIFT pad. It needs Movy UI v13.
undo.full.p: Hold the looper's SHIFT pad (column 1, row 4), X and the selector: everything above plus the audio is erased. The track ends up like new. It can be undone (audio and settings come back). Toast RESET 2.
undo.resetfx: RESET FX: X + selector (row 4). The settings go back to zero and the audio stays. It cannot be undone.
cs.reset.a: Looper SHIFT pad + X + selector (can be undone)
cs.auto.a: PERFORM mode, effect on: hold REC on a playing track and turn K1-K3
cs.perf.a: SHIFT tap = mode; step 1 to 16 = effect (tap = latch, hold = momentary); < and > = page 1/2; up to 6 at once
